description: This file defines the Event class, which manages event registration, triggering, and deregistration within the OpenCart system. It facilitates the registration of event handlers, triggers events to execute associated actions, and manages event data.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Class for managing system events: registration, triggering, and deregistration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Event object with a Registry instance.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event trigger with an associated action and optional priority.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers all actions registered for a specific event, passing in optional arguments.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a specific event trigger associated with a route.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all actions associated with a specific trigger.
